Semantic radar needs more MAP space.

Post-MFA Bridge & Custom-Domain Micro-Relay

  • ssoTwoFactorBridge.ts bridges hybrid-2FA SSO verification on auth.scripe.org/sso/continue back to {ReturnOrigin}/sso/callback
  • Next.js /api/auth/session/{establish,refresh,logout} enforces Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin, extracts trusted Client-Ip, and honors MaxAge: 0
  • Browser receives first-party __Host-scripe_refresh_token (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax)

Expanded Sudo Retry, Tab Isolation & Split Logout

  • api.service.ts opens <SudoVerificationModal /> cleanly across SudoRevokedOrExpired, DowngradeRefused, and TokenInvalid
  • ActivePrincipal + BroadcastChannel guard multi-tab tenant identity against stale cross-tab writes
  • useAuthLogout defaults logoutScope to 'app' so scr.oidc.session survives local tab sign-out
